title: Descent Into Chaos
description: A young person in an orange jumpsuit runs up a decaying concrete staircase inside a ruined, graffiti-covered building. The stairwell is littered with trash, old posters, and debris while glowing orange light and smoke rise from the lower levels.
prompt: A young person wearing a bright orange jumpsuit sprints up a crumbling concrete staircase in an abandoned brutalist building interior, walls covered in torn propaganda posters and colorful graffiti, metal railings and hanging cages, debris and papers scattered on the steps, orange glow and smoke rising from the flooded bottom level, cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere
